label: diagnostic-banner

notes: High ROM bank (port 0x17=0x00). Contains reset trampoline at 0xF6E30, reset vector at 0xFFFF0, and other resources TBD.

notes: CLI, port 0x16/0x17 writes, JMP FAR C000:0000.
